title: Career Roadmap: Data Analyst
summary: Collect, clean, analyse and interpret data to identify trends, measure business performance and help organizations make evidence-based decisions.

blocks.text: Collect, clean, analyse and interpret data to identify trends, measure business performance and help organizations make evidence-based decisions.

rows.text: Any stream may be eligible for some programmes; Mathematics and statistics are advantageous
BS in Data Science & Applications or B.Sc./B.Tech. in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field
Business analytics, financial analytics, marketing analytics, operations analytics or product analytics
M.Sc. Data Science, Business Analytics or Statistics, or an MBA in Business Analytics, where useful

blocks.text: Check the exact eligibility, entrance requirements and degree-awarding institution for the selected IIT programme.

blocks.label: SQL
blocks.text: Filtering, joins, aggregation, subqueries and window functions.

blocks.label: Spreadsheets
blocks.text: Excel, pivot tables, lookup functions and data cleaning.

blocks.label: Programming
blocks.text: Python with pandas, NumPy and basic data visualisation.

blocks.label: Dashboards
blocks.text: Power BI or Tableau, KPI tracking and report design.

blocks.label: Statistics
blocks.text: Descriptive statistics, probability, correlation and hypothesis testing.

blocks.label: Communication
blocks.text: Explain findings clearly and translate them into business recommendations.
Complete three to four practical projects:

blocks.label: Sales Analysis
blocks.text: Identify revenue trends, top products and regional performance.

blocks.label: Customer Analysis
blocks.text: Examine retention, customer segments and churn patterns.

blocks.label: Business Dashboard
blocks.text: Create an interactive Power BI or Tableau dashboard.

blocks.label: Public Dataset Analysis
blocks.text: Clean a dataset, investigate a question and present evidence-based conclusions.
Publish project documentation with the business question, cleaning steps, analysis, visualizations and recommendations.
Target opportunities at:

items.text: Banks, financial services and fintech companies.

blocks.text: Prioritize practical learning in:

items.text: Excel for data cleaning and reporting.
Cloud data fundamentals, such as AWS or Azure, as an additional skill.

blocks.text: Certifications can strengthen a profile, but demonstrable projects and analytical problem-solving are essential.
Data Analytics Intern
Junior Data Analyst
Data Analyst / Business Intelligence Analyst
Senior Data Analyst → Analytics Lead / Analytics Manager
With additional modelling, experimentation and programming skills, analysts may also transition into data science or product analytics.

items.text: Analytics consulting and business intelligence firms

rows.text: Learn Excel, SQL fundamentals, statistics and data-cleaning techniques.
Practise SQL queries, analyse a dataset using Python and build a dashboard.
Complete two portfolio projects, practise analytical interviews and apply for internships and entry-level roles.

blocks.label: Target-ready profile
blocks.text: Strong SQL, Excel, basic Python, statistical reasoning, dashboard development and two to four well-documented projects demonstrating practical analytical ability.
